inputs.baseline_instrumentation: Timing only plus eager collision-pipeline compilation on the original direct UI thread, to give GPU preparation the same scope as the candidate worker; no physics steps or engine algorithm changes.

settings.cache_definition: Cold uses a fresh application pipeline cache and private XDG/NVIDIA shader-cache paths. Warm immediately reuses that process-independent directory. Driver internal/kernel caches are not claimed flushed.
settings.time_definition: Internal phase timers; direct begins before window creation, Sokol begins at OnInit before renderer setup. Process wall time includes teardown; it is not first-frame latency.
